title: Linden Memberships Dues Schedule and Billing Cycles
content:
Dues for every tier of Linden Memberships are set out below in US dollars. Monthly dues are the dues for one calendar month on the monthly cycle; annual dues are the dues for one membership year on the annual cycle. Where a tier offers only the annual cycle, its monthly dues are shown as 0.00.

## Schedule of dues

| Tier | Monthly dues (USD) | Annual dues (USD) | Dues cycles offered | Dues locked for the membership year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 29.00 | 319.00 | Monthly or annual | No |
| Linden Essential Membership | 79.00 | 869.00 | Monthly or annual | No |
| Linden Family Membership | 199.00 | 2189.00 | Monthly or annual | No |
| Linden Plus Membership | 129.00 | 1419.00 | Monthly or annual | No |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 225.00 | 2500.00 | Monthly or annual | Yes |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 0.00 | 6500.00 | Annual only | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Dues cycles offered.** "Monthly or annual" means the tier offers both the monthly cycle and the annual cycle; "Annual only" means the tier offers the annual cycle alone. The Linden Executive Health Membership is therefore billed only on the annual cycle, and its monthly dues figure of 0.00 reflects that no monthly cycle exists for it.
2. **Price lock.** A "Yes" in the last column means the tier's dues are locked for the membership year. The Linden Premier Concierge Membership and the Linden Executive Health Membership carry the lock; the other four tiers do not.
3. **Base dues.** The figures shown are each tier's base dues, before any dependent add-on.

## Reading the schedule (illustrations)

- A Linden Plus Membership on the monthly cycle has monthly dues of 129.00; the same tier on the annual cycle has annual dues of 1419.00.
- A Linden Connect Virtual Membership may be held on either cycle: 29.00 per calendar month, or 319.00 per membership year.
- A patient choosing the Linden Executive Health Membership has one cycle available, the annual cycle, at 6500.00 per membership year.
